mc.item.ItemBlock.name: net.minecraft.world.item.BlockItem
mc.item.ItemBlock.note: BlockItem 构造需要 (Block, Item.Properties)，签名与 1.12 的 ItemBlock 不同

mc.item.CreativeModeTab.name: net.minecraft.world.item.CreativeModeTab
mc.item.CreativeModeTab.note: 1.19.3+ 创造标签页大改：TAB_MISC 等静态常量已移除（原版页签常量在 net.minecraft.world.item.CreativeModeTabs），Item.Properties#tab 与 Item#fillItemCategory 已移除；1.19.4 中自定义页签用 CreativeModeTab.builder() 构建并在 CreativeModeTabEvent.Register（Mod 总线）中 registerCreativeModeTab 注册，物品加入页签监听 CreativeModeTabEvent.BuildContents 并 event.accept(...)（1.20+ 才改为 Registries.CREATIVE_MODE_TAB DeferredRegister + BuildCreativeModeTabContentsEvent）

mc.item.EquipmentSlot.name: net.minecraft.world.entity.EquipmentSlot
mc.item.EquipmentSlot.note: 1.19.4 起 ArmorItem 构造不再用 EquipmentSlot，改为 ArmorItem.Type（HELMET/CHESTPLATE/LEGGINGS/BOOTS）

mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.name: net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity
mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.note: BlockEntity 构造需要 (BlockEntityType, BlockPos, BlockState)，且需注册 BlockEntityType

mc.world.Level.name: net.minecraft.world.level.Level
mc.world.Level.note: 1.19.4 起伤害来源经 level.damageSources() 获取（DamageSources），DamageSource 静态常量已移除

mc.world.biome.Biome.name: net.minecraft.world.level.biome.Biome
mc.world.biome.Biome.note: 1.19.4 起 Biome#isHumid() 改为 hasPrecipitation()，Biome#getPrecipitation() 改为 getPrecipitationAt(BlockPos)

mc.core.RayTraceResult.name: net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult
mc.core.RayTraceResult.note: HitResult 已拆分为 BlockHitResult / EntityHitResult 子类，按用途选择

mc.core.registries.Registries.name: net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries
mc.core.registries.Registries.note: 1.19.3 起注册表 ResourceKey 常量集中在 net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries（如 Registries.ITEM / Registries.BLOCK）

mc.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.name: net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries
mc.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.note: 1.19.3 起静态注册表实例从 net.minecraft.core.Registry 的常量（Registry.ITEM 等）移至 net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries（BuiltInRegistries.ITEM 等）；动态注册表经 RegistryAccess 获取，RegistryAccess#builtinCopy 已移除

mc.chat.HoverEvent.name: net.minecraft.network.chat.HoverEvent
mc.chat.HoverEvent.note: HoverEvent 构造改为 (HoverEvent.Action<T>, T)，Action 常量为泛型

mc.util.InteractionResultHolder.name: net.minecraft.world.InteractionResultHolder
mc.util.InteractionResultHolder.note: InteractionResultHolder<T> 为泛型，静态工厂 success/pass/fail

mc.damage.DamageSource.name: net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource
mc.damage.DamageSource.note: 1.19.4 起伤害类型数据驱动：DamageSource.GENERIC 等静态常量已移除，改用 level.damageSources().generic() 等（Level#damageSources / Entity#damageSources 返回 DamageSources），构造需要 Holder<DamageType>

mc.effect.MobEffect.name: net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffect
mc.effect.MobEffect.note: 1.12 的 Potion(效果) 对应 MobEffect；药水物品类型是 net.minecraft.world.item.alchemy.Potion，勿混淆

mc.particles.ParticleTypes.name: net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes
mc.particles.ParticleTypes.note: 粒子常量名与 1.12 的 EnumParticleTypes 不同（如 SMOKE_NORMAL -> SMOKE），API 改为 ParticleOptions

mc.sound.SoundEvent.name: net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent
mc.sound.SoundEvent.note: 1.19.3 起 SoundEvent 构造器不再公开：用 SoundEvent.createVariableRangeEvent(ResourceLocation)（或 createFixedRangeEvent(ResourceLocation, float)）创建；注册仍用 DeferredRegister<SoundEvent>

mc.sound.SoundEvents.name: net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents
mc.sound.SoundEvents.note: 1.19.3 起部分常量类型为 Holder.Reference<SoundEvent>（如 GOAT_HORN 系列），使用时可能需 .value() 解包；Music 构造也改为需要 Holder<SoundEvent>

mc.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu.name: net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu
mc.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu.note: Container -> AbstractContainerMenu：需注册 MenuType 并配合 NetworkHooks.openScreen 打开

mc.inventory.Container.name: net.minecraft.world.Container
mc.inventory.Container.note: IInventory -> Container（接口）；模组自身容器推荐改用 IItemHandler/ItemStackHandler 能力

mc.client.Screen.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen
mc.client.Screen.note: GuiScreen -> Screen：渲染改用 PoseStack，控件/输入 API 全面变化，需人工重写渲染与交互代码；1.19.3/1.19.4 追加变化：Widget 接口改名 Renderable、AbstractWidget#renderButton 改名 renderWidget、CenteredStringWidget 改名 StringWidget、GuiComponent 绘制方法改为 static（blitOffset 由 PoseStack 平移代替）、布局控件移至 net.minecraft.client.gui.layouts

mc.client.AbstractContainerScreen.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen
mc.client.AbstractContainerScreen.note: GuiContainer -> AbstractContainerScreen<T extends AbstractContainerMenu>，渲染方法签名全变（1.19.4 仍为 PoseStack，GuiGraphics 是 1.20+）

mc.client.Font.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.Font
mc.client.Font.note: 1.19.4 中 Font#drawInBatch 的 boolean 参数改为 Font.DisplayMode 枚举

mc.client.BlockEntityRenderer.name: net.minecraft.client.renderer.blockentity.BlockEntityRenderer
mc.client.BlockEntityRenderer.note: TESR -> BlockEntityRenderer<T> 接口，render 签名为 (T, float, PoseStack, MultiBufferSource, int, int)，在 EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterRenderers 注册

forge.capabilities.Capability.name: net.minecraftforge.common.capabilities.Capability
forge.capabilities.Capability.note: 1.19.4 中 getCapability 返回 LazyOptional<T>，需用 .orElse(...) / .ifPresent(...) 解包

forge.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider.name: net.minecraftforge.common.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider
forge.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider.note: getCapability(cap, side) 返回 LazyOptional<T>，hasCapability 已移除

forge.capabilities.CapabilityManager.name: net.minecraftforge.common.capabilities.CapabilityManager
forge.capabilities.CapabilityManager.note: 注册方式改为 CapabilityManager.get(new CapabilityToken<>(){}) + RegisterCapabilitiesEvent

forge.fluids.FluidStack.name: net.minecraftforge.fluids.FluidStack
forge.fluids.FluidStack.note: FluidStack 现在包装 net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid（原版流体），构造与 1.12 的 Fluid 不同

forge.fluids.FluidTank.name: net.minecraftforge.fluids.capability.templates.FluidTank
forge.fluids.FluidTank.note: FluidTank 移至 capability.templates 包，构造参数为 (capacity[, validator])

forge.lifecycle.commonSetup.name: net.minecraftforge.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLCommonSetupEvent
forge.lifecycle.commonSetup.note: FMLCommonSetupEvent 需通过 Mod 事件总线监听；注册类内容应改用 DeferredRegister 而不是在此事件中注册

forge.lifecycle.init.name: net.minecraftforge.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLCommonSetupEvent
forge.lifecycle.init.note: 1.12 的 init 阶段与 preInit 在新版中合并为 FMLCommonSetupEvent，注意两个方法可能合并

forge.lifecycle.loadComplete.name: net.minecraftforge.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLLoadCompleteEvent
forge.lifecycle.loadComplete.note: FMLLoadCompleteEvent 需通过 Mod 事件总线监听

forge.lifecycle.serverStarting.name: net.minecraftforge.event.server.ServerStartingEvent
forge.lifecycle.serverStarting.note: ServerStartingEvent 在 Forge 总线（MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS）上监听，用 @SubscribeEvent

forge.lifecycle.serverStopping.name: net.minecraftforge.event.server.ServerStoppingEvent
forge.lifecycle.serverStopping.note: ServerStoppingEvent 在 Forge 总线（MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS）上监听，用 @SubscribeEvent

forge.event.RegisterEvent.name: net.minecraftforge.registries.RegisterEvent
forge.event.RegisterEvent.note: RegisterEvent 与 1.12 的 RegistryEvent.Register<T> 签名不同：用 event.register(ForgeRegistries.Keys.XXX, helper -> ...) 形式，或改用 DeferredRegister

forge.event.PlayerEventFml.name: net.minecraftforge.event.entity.player.PlayerEvent
forge.event.PlayerEventFml.note: 1.12 的 gameevent.PlayerEvent（登录/登出/合成/拾取）已并入 event.entity.player.PlayerEvent 的内部类

forge.event.InputEvent.name: net.minecraftforge.client.event.InputEvent
forge.event.InputEvent.note: InputEvent 移至 client.event 包，内部类结构有变化（KeyInputEvent -> InputEvent.Key 等）

forge.event.ScreenEvent.name: net.minecraftforge.client.event.ScreenEvent
forge.event.ScreenEvent.note: GuiScreenEvent -> ScreenEvent，内部类命名全面变化，需逐个核对

forge.event.RenderGuiOverlayEvent.name: net.minecraftforge.client.event.RenderGuiOverlayEvent
forge.event.RenderGuiOverlayEvent.note: RenderGameOverlayEvent -> RenderGuiOverlayEvent，ElementType 改为 overlay id（VanillaGuiOverlay）

forge.event.RenderLevelStageEvent.name: net.minecraftforge.client.event.RenderLevelStageEvent
forge.event.RenderLevelStageEvent.note: RenderWorldLastEvent 已移除：监听 RenderLevelStageEvent 并判断 getStage() == Stage.AFTER_LEVEL 等
